chapter: On the road with Victor Spencer
title: Celestin at the Bulls Club and rival bands
summary: They discuss what Celestin's band was doing and how Robichaux raided bands.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah. Well I didn't understand what happened to Celestan when Guy Kelly and Kuyper were there.
Well Kuyper, I never remember Kuyper was with a- At the Bulls Club you're talking about? Oh yeah, at the Bulls Club.
What happened to Celestan? He sat in the corner and held his own?

No, well at that time Guy, Campbell and Miss Janet and all of them was playing with Celestan then. Yeah. But I was back there at Chinatown, raising the devil with them boys, you see. We had a guy that was added attraction to that band, you understand, and after he left. See Celestan, anybody come, Sue was buried high, I mean Cindy Desvene too, you know. They were high, frankly all out of town. Now Cindy had a band, Bucket from Chicago and Porter was from Detroit and they had a lot of boys from Natchez and different places. And there was another trumpet player, Eugene Ware and all that bunch, they was with the bands. And then Joe Robichaux started scalping, him and Kill Dee they just started scalping, going around there getting men out of this band, that band, made him up a band when he was back there at the Rhythm Club. Russ went back there with him for a while, you understand. But of course Russ was a better bass or a drum player, he was kind of weak but he just was a good friend of mine, I just let him have it. You know, then I started, I had Manuel Cruz still playing with me at one time, and a different guy. Gilbert Young used to play too with him.
